summary: SI-BONE, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a lease amendment for its corporate headquarters and the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. The Third Lease Amendment with Bixby SPE Finance 11, LLC extends the term to August 31, 2026 (with an option to extend to September 30, 2026) at $43,696/month plus operating expenses. Shareholders voted on director elections and executive compensation; approximately 88% of outstanding shares were represented. This is a routine operational and governance filing, not a special situation.
